items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We were all good buddies. We’d go over to East St. Louis and jam ’til the wee hours of the morning.

ctx.x: He’s a cat that lived over in East St. Louis, and he’s played with Miles [Davis] a lot. As a matter of fact, he was trying to get to New York to – after Miles got established – to come to New York to work with Miles. I think he was killed in an accident or something like that. But I have a funny story about Brooks. We were all good buddies. We’d go over to East St. Louis and jam ’til the wee hours of the morning. One morning we’d been jamming ’til the wee hours, and I finally went home – I’d like to say 4 or 5 or…
